auth_login.codex_oauth_hint: Sign in to Codex with OAuth. Taproot saves the account once you paste the address you land on after signing in.
auth_login.anthropic_oauth_hint: Sign in to Anthropic (Claude) with OAuth. Taproot saves the account once you paste the address you land on after signing in.
auth_login.antigravity_oauth_hint: Sign in to Antigravity with your Google account. Taproot saves the account once you paste the address you land on after signing in.
auth_login.meta_oauth_hint: Open the authorization link and enter the device code if requested. Authentication files are saved automatically after authorization.
auth_login.kimi_ai_oauth_hint: Authorize your kimi.ai international account via device login. A separate kimi-ai authentication file is saved automatically. China and international accounts are not interchangeable.
auth_login.kimi_ai_oauth_start_error: Failed to start Kimi International login:
auth_login.xai_oauth_hint: Sign in to xAI Grok with OAuth. Taproot saves the account once you paste the code or address Grok shows after signing in.
auth_login.plugin_oauth_hint: Sign in to {{name}} through the plugin's OAuth flow. Taproot saves the account when sign-in finishes.
auth_login.xai_callback_placeholder: Paste the code shown by Grok, or the full callback URL
auth_login.xai_callback_hint: Grok may only show a code on the page. Paste that code directly and the app will submit it as http://127.0.0.1:56121/callback?... automatically.
auth_login.xai_callback_required: Please paste the code shown by Grok or the full callback URL first.
auth_login.xai_callback_state_missing: Missing the state for this xAI login. Start xAI login again, then submit the code.
auth_login.oauth_callback_label: Paste the address you land on
auth_login.oauth_callback_hint: After you sign in, your browser opens an http://localhost:... page that does not load. Copy the whole address from the address bar and paste it here.
auth_login.oauth_callback_required: Please paste the full redirect URL first.
auth_login.oauth_callback_success: Callback URL submitted. Continue waiting for authentication.
auth_login.oauth_callback_expired: Taproot no longer has this sign-in. It expired, or the server restarted. Start a new sign-in and paste the address from that one.
auth_login.oauth_callback_other_attempt: This address belongs to an earlier sign-in attempt. Open the link above, sign in, and paste the new address.
auth_login.oauth_callback_status_success: Callback URL submitted, waiting for authentication...
auth_login.missing_state: Unable to retrieve authentication state parameter
auth_login.remote_access_disabled: This login method is not available for remote access. Please access from localhost.
auth_login.step_open_auth_page: Open the sign-in page and authorize
auth_login.step_enter_device_code: Enter this code on the sign-in page
auth_login.waiting_background_hint: Closing this window won't stop sign-in
auth_login.success_saved_hint: The account is saved and now listed under Accounts.
